title:
From scattered
manuals to
inspectable
answers.
note: A portfolio walkthrough for a fictional industrial support team.
narration: Meet Knowledge Workspace: a local AI support platform for the fictional Northline Industrial Systems. Follow a technician from a device fault to an answer, then inspect the evidence behind it.

title:
One workspace.
Eleven source
documents.
body: Product manuals, warranty rules, and company policies stay connected to their processing status.
narration: The workspace organizes eleven source documents across three knowledge bases. Administrators can upload, preview, parse, split, and embed files, while checking their status in one place.

title:
Check the text
before it reaches
the model.
body: Inspect extracted text and tables before chunking and embedding.
narration: Start with the input. This spreadsheet contains the gateway fault codes. The parsing preview exposes the extracted table, so an engineer can check the content before indexing it.

title:
See what the
retriever actually
found.
body: Inspect ranked passages, source documents, scores, and stage timings.
narration: For error five zero two two, retrieval testing exposes the selected passages, their scores, and timing. The fault-code reference appears first, making retrieval behavior visible before generation.

title:
A specific fault.
A specific model.
A concise answer.
body: The live Ollama response returns 20,000 data points for the GTE-3000Pro.
note: Observed answer · source attribution reviewed next
narration: Now ask the assistant about the G T E three thousand Pro. The live local model returns the correct limit: twenty thousand data points. Next, inspect its source attribution.

title:
Correct value.
Wrong source
number.
body: The answer names Source 2. The explicit 20,000 limit is in Source 1.
note: An observed citation defect, retained in this demo.
narration: This capture exposes a citation defect. The answer names source two, but the explicit limit appears in source one. The inspector makes the mismatch visible. Citation accuracy still needs improvement.

title:
Keep the failure.
Retry the step.
Inspect the result.
body: A new completed attempt sits beside the original failure in processing history.
note: Real parse failure and retry · temporary demo fixture
narration: Processing history preserves a failed attempt beside its successful retry. Separately, kill-and-restart tests passed for parsing, splitting, and embedding. Partial output is cleaned before an administrator retries.

title:
Evidence beyond
the happy path.
narration: The development evaluation records one hundred fifty comparisons across fifty questions. Hybrid retrieval passed seventeen of eighteen selected technical fact checks, versus fifteen for vector search. These are development results, not production accuracy.

title:
Run it locally.
Follow the evidence.
Improve what fails.
note: Built on an existing enterprise RAG application.
narration: Run the stack locally with Docker Compose and host Ollama. The repository includes architecture, contribution notes, recovery tests, and documented limitations. I built it on an existing RAG codebase and demonstrated it with fictional company materials.
